title: command.form.steps props, contract version 1
description: The props of the flow steps of the generic command form, a flow step point (PRD 13.4): none. A contribution to it runs as a numbered step of the form of the command it names, before the submit or after the receipt, and may patch the paths its manifest declares or cancel; the core's own confirmation runs last before the submit. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\CommandForm\Domain\Dto\CommandFormStepsV1.
